input.body:
Python SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Breaking changes in v3|body_html=

The next major release of the Python SDK will include breaking changes to the API. Please review the migration guide before upgrading.

}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API, for Python 3.9+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=pip install godzilla-sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.py|language=python|code=from godzilla import Godzilla\n\ngodzilla = Godzilla(api_key=os.environ["GODZILLA_API_KEY"])}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create_pipeline.py|language=python|code=pipeline = godzilla.pipelines.create(\n name="ingest-orders",\n source_connector_id="conn_pg_orders",\n destination_connector_id="conn_snowflake_dw",\n)}}

Replaying dead-lettered events

Wraps the replay action described in Handling errors & retries:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=replay.py|language=python|code=godzilla.events.replay("evt_8f2c1a90")}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Async support|body_html=

Every method has an async counterpart under godzilla.aio for use with asyncio-based applications.

}}

Go SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Breaking changes in v3|body_html=

The next major release of the Go SDK will include breaking changes to the API. Please review the migration guide before upgrading.

}}

A typed client for the v2 REST API for Go 1.18+.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=go get github.com/godzilla-ai/go-sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "os" "github.com/godzilla-ai/go-sdk" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient(sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY"))) _ = client }}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=ctx := context.Background() pipeline, err := client.Pipelines.Create(ctx, &sdk.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", }) if err != nil { panic(err) }}}

Error handling & retries

Wraps error handling as described in Handling errors & retries:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=ctx := context.Background() err := client.Events.Replay(ctx, "evt_8f2c1a90") if err != nil { switch err.(type) { case *sdk.NotFoundError: // Event not found case *sdk.RateLimitError: // Rate limited; retry with backoff default: // Handle other errors } }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Context support|body_html=

All methods accept a context.Context for timeout and cancellation control, making it easy to integrate with Go servers and workers.

}}

Node.js SDK {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Breaking changes in v3|body_html=

The next major release of the Node.js SDK will include breaking changes to the API. Please review the migration guide before upgrading.

}}

A thin, typed wrapper around the v2 REST API for Node.js and TypeScript projects.

Install

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk}}

Create a client

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=client.ts|language=typescript|code=import { Godzilla } from "@godzilla/sdk";\n\nconst godzilla = new Godzilla({ apiKey: process.env.GODZILLA_API_KEY });}}

Create a pipeline

Maps directly onto the Pipelines endpoint — see the Building your first pipeline guide for the concepts.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.ts|language=typescript|code=const pipeline = await godzilla.pipelines.create({\n name: "ingest-orders",\n sourceConnectorId: "conn_pg_orders",\n destinationConnectorId: "conn_snowflake_dw",\n});}}

Listening for webhooks

The SDK includes a signature-verification helper for webhook payloads:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=verify.ts|language=typescript|code=import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "@godzilla/sdk";\n\nconst isValid = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret);}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Retries are built in|body_html=

The SDK retries idempotent requests (GET, and POST with an Idempotency-Key) automatically on 429 and 5xx responses using the same backoff the API itself uses.

}}
